notes: Three new pets — Birdie, Eagle and Gubi — built from requests by the MVPs of the winning factions in World Seasons 8, 9 and 10 (Eagle is S-grade).
Cards stopped by the token limit can now pick up on their own once the limit resets — turn on “Auto-continue when the limit resets” under the red notice in the card details.
You can lock finished cards — a locked card survives [🗑 Reset] and stays pinned at the top of DONE.
With multiple accounts, the Usage tab now lets you view each account — [All] by default; pick an account to see just its usage and activity grid.
Fixed: MCP servers showed “Connected” but weren't available in conversations — the status now reflects what you can actually use.
Also fixed: < and > in code blocks showing up as <, the copy button copying code with non-English text as blank, and schedules not running on time after [Set up again].
